settings.heading: Websites and Shopify stores, designed and built to perform.
settings.text: Seven focused services covering every stage of your online presence, from a first landing page to a complete e-commerce store and its ongoing care.

settings.title: Shopify Store Development
settings.description: Custom Shopify stores built on Online Store 2.0, designed around your brand and structured so your team can manage every page without a developer.
settings.benefits:
A storefront tailored to your brand, not a generic template
Sections and content your team can edit in the theme editor
A buying journey designed to reduce friction from product page to checkout
Clean, maintainable Liquid code that is ready to grow with you
settings.deliverables:
Custom or customised Shopify theme
Homepage, collection, product and content templates
Navigation, search and cart experience
App selection and configuration
Launch checklist and handover training

settings.title: E-commerce Website Development
settings.description: End-to-end e-commerce builds for brands that need more than a storefront: catalogue structure, payments, shipping, and the integrations that keep operations running.
settings.benefits:
A catalogue structure that scales as your range grows
Payment, shipping and tax settings configured for your markets
Integrations that connect your store to the tools you already use
A store built for mobile shoppers first
settings.deliverables:
E-commerce architecture and sitemap
Product, collection and checkout setup
Payment and shipping configuration
Third-party integrations
Pre-launch testing across devices

settings.title: Business Website Design
settings.description: Professional websites for service businesses and companies that need to explain what they do, build trust and turn visitors into inquiries.
settings.benefits:
A clear presentation of who you are and what you offer
Design that reflects the quality of your business
Pages structured to guide visitors toward contacting you
Content you can update yourself
settings.deliverables:
Visual design for all key pages
Responsive development
Contact and inquiry forms
On-page SEO foundations
Content management setup

settings.title: Landing Page Development
settings.description: Focused, fast landing pages for campaigns, product launches and lead generation, built around a single goal and a single call to action.
settings.benefits:
One clear message and one clear action per page
Layouts designed for paid, email and social traffic
Fast loading on mobile connections
Reusable sections for future campaigns
settings.deliverables:
Page structure and copy guidance
Custom design and development
Form or checkout integration
Analytics and conversion tracking setup
Reusable campaign template

settings.title: Website Redesign
settings.description: A considered rebuild of an existing website: sharper design, clearer structure and a modern technical foundation, without losing what already works.
settings.benefits:
A modern look that matches where your brand is today
Simpler navigation and clearer content hierarchy
Existing content and search visibility carefully preserved
A foundation that is easier to maintain
settings.deliverables:
Audit of the current website
New design direction and page designs
Content migration
URL redirects and SEO preservation plan
Launch and post-launch review

settings.title: Website Speed Optimization
settings.description: A technical review and clean-up of your website to improve loading speed, Core Web Vitals and the overall browsing experience.
settings.benefits:
Faster pages for visitors on every device
Better Core Web Vitals foundations
Less unused code, fewer heavy scripts
A clear report of what was changed and why
settings.deliverables:
Performance audit
Image, font and script optimisation
Theme and app clean-up
Before and after measurements
Recommendations for ongoing performance

settings.title: Website Maintenance
settings.description: Ongoing care for your website: updates, fixes, content changes and small improvements, handled by the people who know your site.
settings.benefits:
A reliable team to call when something needs attention
Updates and fixes handled before they become problems
Continuous small improvements instead of big rebuilds
Predictable support arrangements
settings.deliverables:
Scheduled updates and checks
Bug fixes and troubleshooting
Content and layout updates
Monitoring of key pages and forms
Regular summary of work completed

settings.title: Discover
settings.text: We learn about your business, audience and goals, review what exists today and agree on scope, priorities and timeline.

settings.title: Design
settings.text: We shape the structure and visual direction, then design key pages for desktop and mobile for your review and feedback.

settings.title: Develop
settings.text: We build the approved designs with clean, responsive code and set up content so every section is easy to edit.

settings.title: Launch & Support
settings.text: We test across devices, launch with care, hand over with training and stay available for improvements.
